decisive_feature: The action creates an unauthorized, non-expiring entry in an access-control system for a residence; the second harm is the breach of access control itself rather than a rule or contract violation.
why: Granting an unapproved person permanent unlock rights both undermines the integrity of the access-control system and exposes residents to unauthorized physical entry. Exceeding the resident's authorization is an access-control failure; no specific legal or regulatory obligation is established, so a compliance label is weaker.
